description: Customer Returns agent of the retail network (read-only): the shopper-facing front door for returning goods. It answers where one return stands (the authorization with its disposition, method, state, lines, reverse labels and expiry). It never changes data: authorizing, cancelling and linking labels stay on the REST API.
name: customer-returns

skills.description: Answer one return authorization as this service recorded it: the order and group, the reason code, the disposition decided at authorization (KEEP returnless, NEAREST_RETURNS_CENTER or ORIGIN_NODE), the method (DROP_OFF, or PICKUP while dormant), the state (AUTHORIZED, IN_TRANSIT, RECEIVED, CLOSED_KEEP, CANCELLED, PICKUP_FAILED), the authorized lines with the caller-declared prices and owner refs, the linked reverse-label tracking numbers, the expiry (authorizedAt + 30d) and pricesAbsent. Arguments: authorizationId (required). Answers a 404 problem for an unknown id. Persists nothing.
skills.name: Read one return authorization
